Riverside Hospital outpatient endoscopy unit (fictional)
ERCP procedure report

Patient: Alex Oyelaran (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-5014
Date of service: 2026-10-22
Place of service: Hospital outpatient department
Endoscopist: Dr. Ana Lucia Prieto, MD (fictional)

Procedure performed
ERCP with biliary sphincterotomy and balloon stone extraction.

Indications
Choledocholithiasis on MRCP with mildly elevated liver tests.

Technique
The duodenoscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum and the major papilla was identified. Deep biliary cannulation was achieved with a sphincterotome and guidewire. The cholangiogram showed a dilated common bile duct to 11 mm with two filling defects consistent with stones.
A biliary sphincterotomy was performed with blended current.
Two stones were extracted with an extraction balloon. The final occlusion cholangiogram showed no residual filling defects.

Impression
Choledocholithiasis, cleared after biliary sphincterotomy and balloon extraction.

Recommendations
Advance diet as tolerated. Laparoscopic cholecystectomy is recommended within 6 weeks.
